prompts.text:
Video editing task: character and outfit replacement. Replace the young man in Video 1 with the person shown in Image 1.

STRICT IDENTITY AND OUTFIT RULES:
- The person in the output must be the exact same person as in Image 1: the same face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, facial hair or no facial hair, skin tone, and the same hair color, length and hairstyle.
- The person wears exactly the clothes from Image 1 in every frame. Where Image 1 does not show the lower body, add plain trousers and shoes that match the outfit.
- Remove the black zip sweater, the belt and the light blue jeans of the original man. Remove the white wired earphones completely: no earphones and no cable in any frame.
- Do not keep any facial feature or the light brown hair of the original man in Video 1. His face must not appear in any frame: not his eyes, nose, mouth, jaw or skin.
- The face, the hair and the outfit must match Image 1 in every frame: close-ups, side views, the back of the head, and fast running.
- Do not make the face younger, smoother or more like a model. Keep the real age, skin and face shape of Image 1.

KEEP FROM VIDEO 1 EXACTLY THE SAME:
- The same body movements, dance moves, gestures, singing mouth movements, running, timing and speed.
- The same camera movement, framing, cuts and shot lengths.
- The same phone, which the person holds and then sticks on the outside of the train window.
- The same Paris metro platform, metro train, passengers, posters, lighting and colors.
- The same length as Video 1.

Do not add text, captions, logos or new people. Do not change the background. Realistic iPhone footage with natural skin texture.
